clues.title: A proud woman officer
clues.text: A proud woman officer is shaking hand with her superior.
clues.thought: I have so many to thanks... What should I even say on the podium?

clues.title: Shoulder Insignia of the woman officer
clues.text: A shoulder pad: 1 red stripe in the middle, bearing [1 star].

clues.title: Shoulder Insignia in the presentation box
clues.text: A velvet-lined presentation box holding a new pair of shoulder pads: 1 red stripe in the middle, bearing [3 stars].

clues.title: A senior officer
clues.text: A senior officer is shaking hand with the newly promoted officer.
clues.spoken: Congratulations, glad to see my disciple get promoted. A step closer to being a [Captain].

clues.title: Shoulder Insignia of the senior officer
clues.text: A shoulder pad: [1 big star] in the middle with embroidered oak leaves.

clues.title: The host
clues.text: The host of the ceremony is holding a microphone in one hand and the [Roster] in another.
clues.thought: I haven't flipped a page in my roster yet... This is going to be long...

MVD.etiology: Civil Order, Forensic Inquiries, and Frontier Security
MVD.body:
The **Ministry of Internal Affairs ([MVD])** is the state apparatus responsible for maintaining civic order, legal compliance, and criminal investigations across the Russian SFSR and the [USSR].

**Operational Organization:**
Local municipal operations are administered through District Departments of Internal Affairs ([ROVD]). In the Far East, the **[Vladivostok] Higher School of the [MVD]** serves as the primary regional academy for officer training, procedural jurisprudence, and forensic education.
